product.name: Aurelio SmartSwitch 5.0
product.description: The Aurelio SmartSwitch 5.0 is a compact, wall‑mounted device that transforms any standard outlet into a controllable smart plug. Designed for modern homes, it supports both Wi‑Fi 802.11b/g/n and Zigbee 3.0 protocols, enabling seamless integration with a wide range of home‑automation hubs. The switch features a durable ABS housing with a brushed metal finish, a single on/off button, and an LED status indicator. Users can schedule power cycles, monitor energy usage, and create scenes via the companion app. The device draws a maximum of 5 W when idle and is rated for 16 A, making it suitable for lamps, fans, and small appliances. Its low‑profile design fits easily into any décor, providing convenience without sacrificing style.
